Subject: Vendor setup & PO integration questions

Hi Irene / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get moving. Our procurement team is starting the vendor setup for Orbitex (legal name: Orbitech Logistics) and we want to align on Redwood's intake items and PO/invoice process so we can get a PO out quickly. Quick list of items we need clarified from you: 

- What specific forms do you require to create a vendor (W-9 or W-8, MSA, remittance/correspondence contact)?
- Do you accept POs that reference multiple internal charge codes? Any limits on line-item granularity?
- Invoice submission method (email v. portal) and required invoice fields (PO#, project code, tax ID).
- Standard payment terms (net30? net45?) and whether early-payment discounts are available.
- Do you require a signed MSA before issuing a PO? If so, can you share the redlined MSA or DocuSign link.

We also have a short vendor questionnaire that I can attach for your finance team to fill — attaching here.

Appreciate a checklist of "what you need from us" and "what we can expect from Redwood" so we can coordinate internally.

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Senior Sourcing Manager
Orbitech Logistics

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise intake checklist (we'll attach templates). I've copied Monica (Finance Ops) to help with PO/invoice specifics and Aditya to keep sales aligned on timing.

What we need from you (please send these to procurement@redwoodinference.com):
- Completed W-9 (or W-8 BEN if non-US) — attached: W-9_Orbitech.pdf (fillable)
- Completed vendor questionnaire (you've attached)
- Legal entity name + remit-to address + tax ID + ACH details or remit instructions
- Certificate of Insurance (if applicable) and contact for invoice disputes
- Signed MSA if you need contractual terms; otherwise we can proceed on standard T&Cs for PO values under $50k

What you can expect from Redwood:
- Within 2 business days: Finance will confirm vendor record and provide vendor ID for PO creation
- Within 3-5 business days: First PO can be issued once vendor record is active (assuming MSA in place where required)
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwoodinference.com (preferred). Required fields: PO#, vendor name, remit address, invoice date, line items, and total.
- Default payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt; exceptions (Net45, Net60) must be pre-approved by Finance and will be tied to your procurement SLA

Attachments I am sending now: PO_template.xlsx (our preferred PO layout), W-9_Orbitech.pdf (fillable).

If you need the MSA sent for signature I can generate the DocuSign link — Aditya / Monica, please confirm.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

2) Invoice vs PO: Does Redwood prefer vendor-submitted invoices tied to POs, or do you sometimes issue POs and then request vendor invoices after delivery?

Hi Maria — Monica from Finance Ops here. Thanks for the completed questionnaire — everything looks in order. Answers to your clarifications below: 

1) PO numbering / multiple charge codes: Yes, we can accept a single PO with multiple line items/charge codes. Please include a master PO# on the invoice and list your internal charge codes on separate lines. Our AP system will map line items to GL buckets based on the PO line descriptions.

2) Invoice vs PO flow: Standard flow is Redwood issues a PO, vendor submits invoice referencing the PO (invoices@redwoodinference.com). In limited cases for services we will accept pre-invoice arrangements — flag those in the vendor onboarding form and they'll be reviewed separately.

3) ACH setup: We require bank routing, account number, and a voided check or bank letter for ACH enrollment. Send those via secure upload (I can provide a one-time SFTP link) OR via our shared secure Drive folder.

4) Payment terms: Standard is Net 30. For this new vendor relationship we can offer Net 30 with an automatic review after 90 days. If you need Net 45/60 please flag and provide a short business justification; approvals are possible but not guaranteed.

Next steps / timeline: 
- Today: I will create the vendor record and send a vendor ID to procurement@orbitech.io (expected within 2 business days).
- By EOD Fri 14 May: Redwood will issue an initial PO referencing DEAL-2027-0489 once vendor ID is validated and MSA status is confirmed.
- Please upload ACH docs to the secure folder or respond to this thread to request the SFTP link.

Attaching the signed MSA for your records (Signed-MSA-redwood.pdf). If you want DocuSign for countersignature, let me know and I will send the envelope.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
